components.role: Random search is utilized as a baseline method for comparing optimization and search efficiency against Bayesian optimization and other strategies.
Bayesian optimization serves as an advanced surrogate-based search or tuning method that efficiently navigates configuration and design spaces under a limited evaluation budget.
Prediction tasks or evaluation outcomes provide the objective metrics and predictions (such as performance or reconstruction quality) that guide the optimization process.

target_task.text: The combination targets optimization and model selection tasks where expensive evaluations or limited feedback budgets constrain the search for optimal configurations.

limitation.text: Traditional random search and manual tuning can be inefficient, requiring extensive trial-and-error and failing to identify strong configurations early under restricted evaluation budgets.

combination.text: Bayesian optimization uses probabilistic models to guide the search for better configurations and evaluate acquisition functions, frequently outperforming baseline random search in finding superior configurations within limited evaluation budgets.

jtbd.text: Personalizing exoskeleton assistance across operating conditions where time and physical effort required to collect user feedback are constrained.

value_prop.text: Bayesian optimization can improve reconstruction and preference-based outcomes relative to independent learning when preferences vary smoothly.

riskiest_assumption.text: Target users will actively adopt and value a Bayesian optimization tool for constrained prediction and search workflows over familiar trial-and-error or random search methods, given that axis D score is 1.0.

mvp.text: Create a demand landing page outlining the Bayesian optimization and prediction tool, and conduct problem interviews with prospective users to assess interest in replacing random search.
mvp.type: demand landing page and problem interviews

success_metric.text: Achieve a proposed threshold of 20 percent visitor conversion on the landing page and secure at least 10 qualitative interview commitments from target users.

kill_criteria.text: Fewer than a proposed threshold of 5 percent visitor conversion on the landing page and zero interview sign-ups after 3 weeks.

open_source.use: Active fine-tuning library for active learning and optimization tasks.
Hyperparameter optimization and scheduling package for resource-constrained search.

to_build.text: A unified workflow interface integrating Bayesian optimization acquisition functions with prediction models and random search baselines.
